# Nuka World on Tour: Seismic Activity Event Guide

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 3, 2022
- 5 min read

Updated: Jul 29, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_285755fc5e15461284aade8fbe77c1e5~mv2.jpg)

****SUBJECT TO CHANGE PORTING TO LIVE SERVERS****

With thanks to Garust, Vicyorus and SugarBombs.Rads and a HUGE thanks to Coffee888, you are the best PTS testing buddy a person could ask for.

This guide is broken up into the following sections:

- Recommended items
- The Titan's stats
- Questline
- How to start the event
- Step by step of the event
- Rewards

Seismic Activity (or the Titan) is part of the Nuka World on Tour DLC that drops in December 2022.

This event will be permanently added to the Public Event list.

A notification will appear in the top left hand corner of your screen and in the World Activity tab in the bottom left hand corner of your screen.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b6e807af6caa4696a2df0a69afd654b3~mv2.jpg)

It is recommended that you run the following gear and perk cards to make the event a little easier:

- Melee weapon
- Funky Duds Legendary Perk Card or Posion Resist legendary armour rolls or food buffs
- Glow Sight perk card under Perception
- Turn off all unrelated event and quest map markers in your Pip-Boy

#### **__The Titan's stats__**

__The Titan's stats__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7636c500366e4c4a8124a57c68b72c81~mv2.jpg)

- 30,000 base HP
- Heals to full upon first reaching 50% HP, like other Legendary enemies
- 70% damage reduction on all incoming damage
- 350 resistance to fire
- 400 resistance to all other damage types, including rads.
- Hunter's and Zealot's Prefix weapons do not work on the Titan, nor does ultracite ammo.

#### **__Questline__**

__Questline__

You do not need to start or complete the questline to spawn the Titan.

A questline has been added to the game to explain the lore and backstory of the Titan.

To start the quest "What Slept Beneath," speak with Pete (found sitting at the table, on the left side of the Nuka-Cade),

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d7104fde279e445fb9fd573a6e26509f~mv2.jpg)

For spoiler reasons, I won't be covering the questline here. However it is a simple-to-follow questline; just follow the prompts and map markers.

The quest normally takes about an hour, but can be speedrun in about 30 minutes.

The quest uses SPECIAL and addiction checks. It is recommended that you bring a set of Unyielding body armour or some food buffs with you while completing this quest.

The checks include:

- 3+ and 4+ Perception
- 6+, 7+ and 8+ Intelligence
- 15+ Luck
- Addicted to Buffout, Calmex, Med-X, Mentats, or Pyscho

The quest rewards

- XP (base 250xp)
- Caps (base 30c) if you hand in just the holotape
- Caps (base 60c) if you hand in the holotape and the supplies

#### **__How to start the event__**

__How to start the event__

As with the other end bosses in this game, you will need to launch a nuke to spawn the Titan.

There are a few nuke placements available, as seen in the photos below.

The hit box is a bit iffy, and the entire Abandoned Mine Shaft 2 icon needs to be covered in order to spawn the Titan and start the event.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ba818b69b5964d55b9472b246df29bce~mv2.jpg)

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e83d994e6d094fd5b1678106ca999236~mv2.jpg)

Image credit: __nukaknights.com__ 

#### **__Step by step walkthrough of the event__**

__Step by step walkthrough of the event__

Once the nuke hits Abandoned Mine Shaft 2, the weather will change, and 11 large ultracite shards (crystals) will form.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_6a6b9c41496d4f6dabd4595e96c86b03~mv2.jpg)

You have 10 minutes to destroy all 11 crystals using a **__melee weapon__**.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9de4a3194bbb4fc0bd2db250dc2a86aa~mv2.jpg)

If you try to destroy the crystals using a non-melee weapon, you will get a popup notification on the top left hand corner of the screen.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a53ccbabc7cc407ca4456e700b863156~mv2.jpg)

Once you have destroyed the 11 crystals, the Titan will emerge.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_35e91dd24597451297d285639138bc01~mv2.jpg)

**Phase 1**

You have 3.5 minutes to destroy the three crystals and take at least 20% of the Titan's health.

You **MUST** do a minimum of 20% damage to the Titan during each of the first three phases or the Titan will not move to the next location and the event will fail. 

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_43caf5422fc64674b3b91f98f5952b05~mv2.jpg)

The Titan will not take damage until you destroy the three crystals.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_c86becfe950249368e765a430117facd~mv2.jpg)

Once you have completed Phase 1 and taken at least 20% of his health, the Titan will disappear underground and reappear at the Phase 2 location.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_91770f61c9054445936d71e198099db7~mv2.jpg)

**Phase 2**

You have 3.5 minutes to destroy the four crystals and take at least 20% of the Titan's health.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_41197be47bb7452285d21f20c2643d2a~mv2.jpg)

The Titan will not take any damage until you destroy the four crystals.

Once you have completed Phase 2, the Titan will disappear underground and reappear at the Phase 3 location.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_fb730e6988564f64a992a903f5093f9b~mv2.jpg)

**Phase 3**

You have 3.5 minutes to destroy the five crystals and take at least 20% of the Titan's health.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_0bb176b8fb374d86a2c7fd10d9950751~mv2.jpg)

The Titan will not take damage until you destroy the five crystals.

Once you have completed Phase 3, the Titan will disappear underground and reappear at the Phase 4 location—the final location.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e1d0f570d28a4230b4eb4f3a77d42228~mv2.jpg)

**Phase 4**

You have 3.5 minutes to destroy the six crystals and take the Titan's remaining health.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e6df352f5e8243af852a8ed6002c2e26~mv2.jpg)

Once the Titan has been destroyed, you can loot the body.

Standard loot found on the Titan's body includes:

- 1*, 2* or 3* weapon or armour piece
- Caps
- Ammo
- Grenades/mines
- Non-legendary weapon
- Stimpaks
- Ultracite scrap

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b8a988cf2abb429196c0b01dcb52aef7~mv2.jpg)

### **__Seismic Activity rewards__**

__Seismic Activity rewards__

**Seismic Activity event rewards**

- Treasury Notes x3
- Legendary Scrip / Modules 1-3
- 2 flux scrap
- 2-3 repair kits
- Molerat jerky
- Nuka Cola variety (Nuka Cola, Nuka Cherry or empty Nuka Bottle)
- Aid (stimpak, rad-away, rad-x, etc)
- Ammo (random)
- Nuka Cola Twist
- Nuka Food item (full list and buffs __here__ )
- Caps (base 200c)
- XP (base 1200xp)
- Nuka-Cade points (5000 points)
- Plan
- One of two event reward weapons

The Seismic Activity event also pulls from the Nuka World on Tour generic loot pool. However, you will only recieve one plan per event.
